messages:
Alex W: quick check — I'm about to push a Terraform change to add a new nodegroup 'inference-gpu-3' in us-west-2a. Plan: prefer g5.12xlarge spot, fallback to on-demand. Thinking to attach an EC2 capacity reservation for a subset of r/w latency-sensitive capacity. Anyone object or have sizing recs? PR: https://git.redwood/pulls/2345

Priya N: +1 on PR ping. A few practical notes:
- I wouldn't reserve for medium-size g5s unless Finance ok's the burn. Reserve for p4/a100 if we need tight SLOs.
- If you do reserve, do it via launch template spec: e.g.
```terraform
resource "aws_launch_template" "inference_lt" {
  name_prefix = "inference-lt-"
  ...
  capacity_reservation_specification {
    capacity_reservation_preference = "open"
    capacity_reservation_target {
      capacity_reservation_id = "cr-0abc12345"
    }
  }
}
```
- For spot fallback we usually run a paired on-demand nodegroup with lower replica target and taint spot nodes: `inference=preemptible:NoSchedule`. Runtime will tolerate.
- Also add node label `gpu.workload=high-memory` so helm charts can nodeSelector rather than tolerating everything.

Miguel R: couple infra bits from autoscaler side:
- cluster-autoscaler flags we use: `--balance-similar-node-groups`, `--expander=random`, `--max-node-provision-time=15m` (spot can take a bit), `--scale-down-delay=10m`.
- For mixed-instance policy prefer launch template + overrides, and set `on_demand_percentage_above_base_capacity` to 10-20% so we keep a small guaranteed baseline.
- If you want instant fallback set up node-group priorities (on-demand higher priority).

Sara L: secrets/iam notes:
- Use IRSA for node role bits (avoid embedding creds in tfvars). Node IAM role needs: S3 GetObject (model cache), CloudWatch metrics, and permission to call STS for spot-interruption-handler if we run one.
- Don't store capacity reservation IDs in git — put them in SSM or Secrets Manager and reference via tf data source.

Alex W: thanks. @Miguel R can you take a quick look at the mixed instance policy and autoscaler flags in the PR? I'll add the taint `inference=preemptible:NoSchedule` and add tolerations to the runtime helm values.yaml.

Miguel R: on it, will review today. small suggestion: consider g5.8xlarge instead of 12x for better packing (more nodes <-> better preempt distribution). Also double-check zone spread: prefer creating reservations across 2 AZs, not a single AZ if our SLO allows it.

Priya N: +1 to AZ spread. If we must pin to us-west-2a for latency, then reserve only a small slice (eg, 2-4 instances) and rely on on-demand fallback for scale.

deploy-bot: terraform plan finished for PR #2345 — no changes requiring resource replacement. (plan id: plan-20260317-1123) :white_check_mark:

Alex W: merging in ~2h unless anyone objects. Will only create capacity reservation after Finance sign-off. I'll add a PR note about SSM-stored reservation id and the required IRSA policy.

Miguel R: ack, thanks.

Sara L: ack. Remember to update the helm chart tolerations in the runtime repo so pods land on the right nodes after tainting.
